versions.changelog:
Initial release — turn home internet outages into scoped, documented events with actionable diagnostics.

- Layered network probes isolate fault location (device, Wi-Fi, LAN, router-WAN, DNS, ISP, or platform).
- Automatically prescribes the correct first action (reboot, DNS switch, or escalation) based on fault.
- Logs all diagnostic steps with timestamps for evidence and troubleshooting.
- Generates a ready-to-send ISP complaint package, including outage logs and equipment inventory.
- Supports continuous monitoring to catch and document intermittent or night-time outages.
- Designed for home users, not enterprise/NOC scenarios.
